finance_summary: S&P 500 and Nasdaq hit two-week highs heading into Nvidia earnings, with software stocks leading an AI relief rally. Nvidia shares up 2.2% premarket as investors price in a 'beat and raise' quarter following AMD's Meta deal. VIX has dropped from Monday's 21+ to around 19.5, signaling improved risk sentiment.
